purpose: Test whether retaining the incumbent Q4_K ffn_down dequantized F16 bytes on each local B70 removes repeated dequantization work without changing any generated token.
hardware: Two local Intel Arc Pro B70 cards; no remote host.
fixed_configuration: Qwen3.8-27B Q4_K_M target, TP2 tensor 1,1, MTP0, tuned target profile, Q4_K reorder enabled in both arms, WDC disabled, 64 slots, 32768 total context, batch 2048, ubatch 256, cache-prompt off, temperature 0, seed 42, 128 output tokens per request.

admission_contract.required_client_order: c000 through c063 exactly in one initial cohort

arms: Fresh same-binary control with GGML_SYCL_Q4K_F16_CACHE_FILTER unset.
candidate_delta: For Q4_K ffn_down tensors only, allocate a per-tensor/per-device persistent F16 buffer, fill it once with the incumbent to_fp16_sycl routine, and reuse those exact bytes in the unchanged oneDNN GEMM. No prompt, KV, token, or output cache is enabled.
required_gates: control and candidate each complete all 64 requests at 128 tokens
control and candidate token-ID digests match the frozen ordered MTP0 oracle 64/64
all cached token counts are zero
complete token-ID identity and collision gates pass
candidate cache liveness marker is present and control marker is absent
WDC is absent in both arms
no GPU fault, reset, device loss, OOM, model-process segfault, or unclean shutdown
advance_rule: Promote only if the candidate is 64/64 exact and repeatably improves aggregate throughput against the same-binary control. If ffn_down passes, wider role sets require separate preregistered exact gates.
publication_policy: The fresh-server cohort includes model-weight cache construction; only output-qualified measured rates may be reported. No interpolation, fixture gaming, prompt/output caching, or extrapolation. A realistic diverse-prompt exact suite remains required before a headline promotion.
